title: AI angiography detects more reference coronary lesions than visual estimation
summary: An ensemble-based angiography system detected 1,705 of 1,828 manually defined coronary lesions in 420 patients, compared with 69% detection by visual estimation. Models trained on separate 2016 data were tested retrospectively on selected 2022 images from three hospitals. The result establishes reference-based lesion detection, not improved treatment outcomes.
ai_technology: MPXA-2000; DeepLabV3+, U-Net++ and U²-Net segmentation ensemble
organization: Asan Medical Center; University of Ulsan College of Medicine; Ulsan University Hospital; Keimyung University Dongsan Medical Center

source_review.scope: Read actual primary cohort, separate model-training data, named segmentation ensemble, blinded manual/AI/visual-reference Methods, detection definition, statistical Methods, Results and limitations. Supplementary training tables were not independently inspected. Exact primary identity/date and fresh primary PubMed correction/retraction relationships checked.

evidence.tested: Retrospective three-center evaluation of 1,076 selected angiography images from 420 patients. Nine view-specific segmentation models combined DeepLabV3+/EfficientNet-B4, U-Net++/EfficientNet-B4 and U²-Net; training images from 2016 were separate from 2022 evaluation data. Against blinded manual QCA, the system detected 1,705/1,828 lesions (93%) versus 69% for visual estimation; on multiple-lesion images it identified all reference lesions in 86% versus 33%.
evidence.unknown: Manual QCA is the anatomical reference, not physiological significance or clinical outcomes. Selected frames excluded occlusions and poor-quality images; only reference lesions meeting size/stenosis criteria were counted. Lesion observations repeat within patients, and reported significance does not establish cluster-adjusted uncertainty. No prospective procedural or patient benefit was tested; training details in the supplementary material were not independently inspected.
evidence.ai_role: Learned vessel segmenters generated lumen boundaries; an ensemble and downstream lesion analysis located and quantified lesions for comparison with manual QCA and cardiologist visual estimates.
